subject.title: [Feature]: Per-event turn-acceptance result for ack-first webhook channels (reply-lane admission / durable receive contract)

question: Should ack-first channels standardize on a channel-inbound acceptance result now, and should LINE use it as an opt-in redelivery gate or move directly toward spool-before-ack?
rationale: The missing signal and ownership invariant are well supported, but the public SDK seam and LINE durability target are compatibility-sensitive product choices.

options.title: Add inbound result first
options.body: Extend runtime.channel.inbound and MessageReceiveContext with one settled result, retain after_receive_record as LINE's default, and let the linked PR add opt-in acceptance-gated acknowledgement.

options.title: Design durable spool first
options.body: Make durable ingress-journal ownership the acknowledgement boundary and defer the lighter acceptance-result contract until that spool design is complete.

options.title: Keep channel-local outcomes
options.body: Avoid a new SDK contract and continue maintaining separate Telegram and LINE lifecycle implementations.

recommendation.title: Add inbound result first
recommendation.body: Extend runtime.channel.inbound and MessageReceiveContext with one settled result, retain after_receive_record as LINE's default, and let the linked PR add opt-in acceptance-gated acknowledgement.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked product direction already identifies the canonical contract requirement, and this decision defines the public channel SDK boundary.
